items.title: Johnny Varro interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001
items.q: William B. Williams especially in New York, WNEW had a lot of that stuff going on

ctx.x: Yeah, Goodman and some of those things. You’d hear a trio and you’d listen to Make Believe Ballroom and some of those shows, William B. Williams especially in New York, WNEW had a lot of that stuff going on and later on Fred Robbins took over and was playing mostly jazz.
I see. So you didn’t really have to search the dial to find jazz oriented music like you do now?
